paper_id: Li et al. - 2020 - Experience aging or glitching why does android stop responding and what can we do about it
title: Experience: Aging or Glitching? Why Does Android Stop Responding and What Can We Do About It?
motivation: Android用户频繁遇到ANR/SNR导致直接用户体验中断,但学界对其流行程度和根因缺乏大规模实测理解
problem_framing: 在30000台真实手机上进行众包测量,构建自动化根因分析pipeline对ANR/SNR事件进行聚类和诊断
key_insight: WAM的discard命令因fsync变成准同步阻塞写入,是ANR/SNR最大根因(35%),可通过细粒度批处理消除
method_signature: Android-MOD修改200行代码收集系统调用栈,wait-for图定位关键线程,similar-stack聚类自动分类根因
evaluation_criteria: WAM修复后>99%消除相关ANR/SNR,写速度仅下降3%,已部署至约20M用户
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 资源竞争和内存不足是经典OS挑战,没有银弹;应用缺陷更是无法根本解决
evidence_for_taste: hardware does not seem to relieve the problem
ANR and SNR are more of a software issue
no silver bullet for bugs and defects
surprising find that largest root cause comes from flawed design
simple system tuning can yield great performance benefits
domain knowledge could be properly applied to enhance ML quality
thinking_moves: 从现象(ANR/SNR高发)追溯到系统设计缺陷而非硬件或应用bug
用wait-for图将阻塞传播链逆向追踪到最关键线程
将异构特征分离使用不同相似度度量后再合并以提高聚类精度
将real-time WAM和lazy WAM两极策略折中为细粒度批处理
用领域知识指导ML特征表示而非盲目调参
